blind_spots.blind_spot: Sells snickerdoodle into DoD and Fortune 100 alike with zero ATO/RMF/CMMC/ITAR language, despite an Army SBIR specifically targeting Robotic Combat Vehicle sensor fusion.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A sensor-fusion board destined for an RCV program of record needs a compliance and ATO path well before fielding; treating it as an OEM dev-kit sale risks the same 'demo worked, transition died' failure as any other Phase II that never budgeted for RMF.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Company voice is calibrated to a maker/OEM audience (CrowdSupply interviews, reseller pitches) rather than an acquisition audience.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Used by companies ranging from individuals and startups to Fortune 100 corporations and the DoD, this "prototype-to-production" platform enables...

blind_spots.blind_spot: No discussion anywhere of how snickerdoodle's 'wireless connectivity' and edge-computing pitch behaves under denied/degraded RF — the exact condition the Army xTechSBIR Autonomy work is meant to address.
blind_spots.operator_reality: The canonical DDIL failure mode (a system built assuming continuous connectivity breaks the moment the link is denied) applies directly to a sensor-fusion platform meant for robotic combat vehicles operating in contested spectrum.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Marketing copy for snickerdoodle/piSmasher is written for the commercial edge-AI/IoT market, not re-written for the DoD-specific contracts layered on top.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: The convenience of wireless connectivity... The ideal platform for artificial intelligence and machine learning at the edge.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Four separate SBIR/STTR contract threads (Army xTechSBIR P1+P2, SDA Direct-to-Phase-2, SpaceWERX STTR) running simultaneously through an 8-person company, with no visible advocacy-chain or transition-planning language on the site.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Each of those Phase II clocks is an independent valley-of-death risk; a team this size juggling four agency relationships has no slack to also own deployment architecture, ATO paperwork, and sustainment planning for whichever program transitions first.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Site content is proud-of-award press-release style, not program-management or transition-risk framing.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: krtkl has been awarded a follow-on contract under the US Army Research Laboratory's xTechSBIR Autonomy initiative. This Phase 2 contract will build upon krtkl's Phase 1 efforts...

opener_hook: krtkl, Visimo, and Textron Systems are building a sensor-fusion platform for Robotic Combat Vehicles under a US Army SBIR — how does snickerdoodle's fusion pipeline handle the RCV's link going DDIL mid-mission?
what_they_do: Makes snickerdoodle, a business-card-sized reconfigurable ARM+FPGA embedded computer sold as a prototype-to-production platform for edge AI/sensing, with commercial OEM sales plus multiple DoD SBIR/STTR awards (Army, Space Force, SDA).
